scripts.preview:drafts: rm -rf .preview && cp -R public .preview && node scripts/build-site.mjs --drafts --out .preview && npx wrangler@latest pages dev .preview
scripts.check: node --check public/assets/app.js && node scripts/build-site.mjs --check && node scripts/check-static.mjs && node scripts/check-seo.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy public --project-name nurevo --branch production
